newsitem.title: USA: Intermedia offers Fla. network access point.
newsitem.headline: Intermedia offers Fla. network access point.

text.p: Intermedia Communications Inc said on Thursday it would create Florida's first Internet network access point to serve the southeastern United States, Caribbean, South America and Central America.

Intermedia, an integrated telecommunications service provider said the network access point, based in Miami, would offer a high-speed Internet exchange point for Internet service and content providers.
The company said it was creating the point in response to growing customer demand.

"They are expressing the need for localized traffic exchange points to reduce the congestion, backhaul and network dependency issues they face today," said Robert Browne, Intermedia's Internet services product manager.
The point would provide an open, high-capacity traffic exchange at speeds in excess of 100 megabits per second and strengthen Intermedia's internet services, the company said.
Access would come over Intermedia's fiber optic network facilities in the Miami area and its frame relay network, it said.
